title: Local and global well-posedness for the extended Schrödinger-Benjamin-Ono system
summary: We study the well-posedness problem for the extended Schrödinger-Benjamin-Ono system (eSBO) on the real line. This system couples a Schrödinger field $u$ with a Benjamin-Ono type field $v$, including a term of the form $\partial_{x}(v^2)$. This latter term, just as in the case of the Benjamin-Ono equation, causes the system to become quasilinear and unsolvable via Picard iteration. We prove that eSBO is locally well-posed in $H^{s+\frac 12}(\mathbb{R})\times H^{s}(\mathbb{R})$ for any $s\geq 0$.
